SELECT R.RSD_BRD_ID, R.OPEN_YN, R.REQ_STATUS, B.BRD_CODE, B.BLDG_ID, B.MBR_CD, B.BRD_TITL_NM, B.BRD_CONT, B.BRD_PBLS_DTM, B.BRD_VW_CNT, B.BRD_MOD_DTM, B.BRD_DEL_YN, R.RSD_BRD_DEL_YN, M.MBR_NNM, R.REPLY_CONT FROM RESIDENT_BOARD R JOIN BOARD B ON R.RSD_BRD_ID = B.BRD_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MBR_CD = M.MBR_CD
R.RSD_BRD_ID = #{rsdBrdId} AND R.RSD_BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( BRD_NO, BRD_CODE, BLDG_ID, MBR_CD, BRD_TITL_NM, BRD_CONT, BRD_PBLS_DTM, BRD_VW_CNT, BRD_DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{rsdBrdId}, #{brdCode}, #{bldgId}, #{mbrCd}, #{rsdBrdTitl}, #{rsdBrdCont}, #{rsdBrdPblsDate}, 0, 'N' )

INSERT INTO RESIDENT_BOARD ( RSD_BRD_ID, BRD_CODE, MBR_CD, BLDG_ID, OPEN_YN, REQ_STATUS, RSD_BRD_PBLS_DTM, RSD_BRD_MOD_DTM, RSD_BRD_DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{rsdBrdId}, #{brdCode}, #{mbrCd}, #{bldgId}, #{openYn}, #{reqStatus}, SYSDATE,SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE RESIDENT_BOARD SET REPLY_CONT = #{replyCont}, REQ_STATUS = '002', ANS_DT =SYSDATE WHERE RSD_BRD_ID = #{rsdBrdId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BOARD B JOIN RESIDENT_BOARD R ON B.BRD_NO = R.RSD_BRD_ID JOIN BUILDING H ON B.BLDG_ID = H.BLDG_ID LEFT JOIN TENANCY T ON H.RENTAL_PTY_ID = T.RENTAL_PTY_ID LEFT JOIN UNIT_RESIDENT UR ON H.BLDG_ID = UR.BLDG_ID WHERE R.RSD_BRD_ID = #{rsdBrdId} AND R.RSD_BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( (R.OPEN_YN = 'Y' AND UR.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd}) OR (B.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd}) OR (T.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd}) ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL
